entries.title: Joshua 4:3
segments: All proper care should be taken to keep in mind the mercies of the Lord; and to transmit a knowledge of them to our children and all coming generations.

entries.title: Joshua 4:6
segments: A sign; a monument to commemorate the dividing of the river Jordan, and to transmit the knowledge of it to future generations.

It is wisely ordered that children should be inquisitive.  It opens the way to communicate instruction in a form most interesting and useful. Such opportunities should be diligently improved by parents and all intrusted with the education of the young.

entries.title: Joshua 4:7
segments: For ever; as long as the knowledge of this event should continue.

entries.title: Joshua 4:10
segments: When in obedience to God we have taken the place and engaged in the service which he has assigned us, we should patiently abide in it till he in his providence bids us leave it, and then we should go to any other place and engage in any other service to which he calls us.

entries.title: Joshua 4:12
segments: The friends of God should remember that they belong to one family, and have one common cause.  Most gladly, therefore, should each portion pursue the course which is best for the whole, and in so doing they will subserve their own best interests.

entries.title: Joshua 4:14
segments: The Lord magnified Joshua; by the manner in which he led the Israelites over the Jordan.
They who most heartily and faithfully follow the directions of god, will in due time be most highly honored.

entries.title: Joshua 4:18
segments: What are called laws of nature, are stated modes of God's operation, which he can continue or change, as he sees best.

entries.title: Joshua 4:19
segments: The tenth day of the first month; forty years, wanting five days, from the time they left Egypt, and on the day that the paschal lamb was to be set apart for sacrifice.

entries.title: Joshua 4:20
segments: Pitch; literally, rear up; that is, into a conspicuous heap.

entries.title: Joshua 4:24
segments: When God words wonders, they are not for any particular people or period merely, but for all people in all ages, and are designed and adapted to make known his character to the universe for ever.
